emails.subject: Henderson acquisition — moving forward
emails.body: Hi — just a heads up that we're moving forward on the Henderson acquisition. Paperwork and dates to follow shortly. Nothing needed from you yet.

emails.subject: Henderson signing date
emails.body: The Henderson contract signing is locked for {!signing = serve+5d}. Please put it on Marcus's calendar.

emails.subject: Project kickoff
emails.body: Once Henderson signs, get the project kickoff on the calendar for two weeks after the signing.
